FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}

  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)

  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)

panels.title: Evening Briefing (22:00 — Day So Far & Tonight's Target)
Sleep Duration (Apple Watch vs Oura Separate) & 14-Day Sleep Debt

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       MAX(dm.value) AS "Apple Watch Sleep (hr)"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration'
  AND dm.source = 'apple_health'
  AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       MAX(dm.value) AS "Oura Ring Sleep (hr)"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration'
  AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

panels.title: Autonomic Recovery & Early Illness / Strain Signals

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(dm.value) AS "Apple Watch HRV (SDNN)",
       AVG(dm.baseline_mean) AS "SDNN 60d Baseline"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_sdnn'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(dm.value) AS "Oura HRV (RMSSD)",
       AVG(dm.baseline_mean) AS "RMSSD 60d Baseline"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_rmssd'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') AS "RHR_AppleWatch",
       AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') AS "RHR_Oura",
       AVG(dm.baseline_mean) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') AS "Baseline_60d"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') AS "Resp Rate — Watch (br/min)",
       AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') AS "Resp Rate — Oura (br/min)"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'respiratory_rate'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(CASE WHEN dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature_delta' THEN dm.value ELSE (dm.value - dm.baseline_mean) END) AS "Watch_Temp_Delta_C"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.source = 'apple_health'
  AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'
  AND (
    dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature_delta'
    OR (dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND dm.baseline_mean IS NOT NULL)
  )
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       AVG(CASE WHEN dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature_delta' THEN dm.value ELSE (dm.value - dm.baseline_mean) END) AS "Oura_Temp_Delta_C"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')
  AND (
    dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature_delta'
    OR (dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND dm.baseline_mean IS NOT NULL)
  )
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

panels.title: Cross-Wearable Comparison: Oura Ring vs Apple Watch (Side-by-Side & Daily Delta)

properties.value: Mean Heart Rate Δ (Oura − Watch, bpm)
HRV Δ (Oura RMSSD − Watch SDNN, ms)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       (AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')) AS "Sleep_Delta_hr"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
HAVING COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
   AND COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       (AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')) AS "HR_Delta_bpm"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'heart_rate'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
HAVING COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
   AND COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       (AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')) AS "RHR_Delta_bpm"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate'
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
HAVING COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
   AND COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       (AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')) AS "Temp_Delta_C"
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}

  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day, u.timezone
HAVING COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
   AND COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%') > 0
ORDER BY dm.day ASC;

SELECT (dm.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE u.timezone) AS time,
       (AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_rmssd' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_sdnn' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')) AS "HRV_Delta_ms"

HAVING COUNT(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_rmssd' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) > 0

panels.title: Mean Heart Rate & Skin Temperature: Apple Watch vs Oura Ring

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dm.day::text AS day,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')::numeric, 2)::double precision AS watch_sleep_hr,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS oura_sleep_hr,
       ROUND((AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'sleep_duration' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS sleep_diff_hr,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'heart_rate' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')::numeric, 2)::double precision AS watch_hr_bpm,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'heart_rate' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS oura_hr_bpm,
       ROUND((AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'heart_rate' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'heart_rate' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS hr_diff_bpm,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_sdnn' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')::numeric, 2)::double precision AS watch_hrv_sdnn_ms,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_rmssd' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS oura_hrv_rmssd_ms,
       ROUND((AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_rmssd' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'hrv_sdnn' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS hrv_diff_ms,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')::numeric, 2)::double precision AS watch_rhr_bpm,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS oura_rhr_bpm,
       ROUND((AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'resting_heart_rate' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS rhr_diff_bpm,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%')::numeric, 2)::double precision AS watch_temp_c,
       ROUND(AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS oura_temp_c,
       ROUND((AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND (dm.source = 'oura_ble' OR dm.device ILIKE '%oura%')) - AVG(dm.value) FILTER (WHERE dm.canonical_metric = 'skin_temperature' AND dm.source = 'apple_health' AND dm.device NOT ILIKE '%oura%'))::numeric, 2)::double precision AS temp_diff_c
FROM daily_metrics dm
JOIN users u ON u.id = dm.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
  AND dm.canonical_metric IN ('sleep_duration', 'heart_rate', 'hrv_sdnn', 'hrv_rmssd', 'resting_heart_rate', 'skin_temperature')
  AND dm.day >= ($__timeFrom()::date - 1)
  AND dm.day <= ($__timeTo()::date + 1)
GROUP BY dm.day
ORDER BY dm.day DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT to_char(i.created_at AT TIME ZONE u.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS generated_at, i.severity, i.rule_id, i.title, i.finding, i.action
FROM insights i
JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id
WHERE u.slug = ${user_slug:sqlstring}
ORDER BY i.day DESC,
         CASE i.severity WHEN 'alert' THEN 0 WHEN 'watch' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         i.rule_id ASC
LIMIT 25;
